name: Hand-written note with an arrow
description: A short hand-written note in orange marker (slightly tilted, white outline) appears in a corner beside the speaker's head, then a hand-drawn curved arrow draws itself from the note to the speaker's face (or a chosen point) and its arrowhead snaps on.
use_when: Lines that point at the speaker or something on screen: 'this one', 'me', 'that's the guy', 'look at this', 'the raw take'; calling out a person, an object or a detail.

text.help: the note, written as given, e.g. 'THIS ONE' or 'me!'; long notes wrap to two lines

corner.help: where the note sits: top-right | top-left | bottom-right | bottom-left

target_x.help: optional x (0-1080) the arrow points at; default is the face edge

target_y.help: optional y (0-1920) the arrow points at
